name: Project Gutenberg English texts in the public domain
licence: Public domain in the US (texts 'not protected by U.S. copyright law'); the Project Gutenberg licence covers only the trademark and must be stripped with the PG header and footer.
verdict_reason: Public domain, so training and shipping weights needs no licence. PG only guarantees US status, so keep only books whose authors all died before 1956 (public domain under life+70 and India's life+60), and skip any book whose header marks it as copyrighted.
used_for: M3b English LM text, at a small mix weight: the register is old and literary, unlike chat.
notes: Select books with the PG catalogue (pg_catalog.csv, public domain, about 21 MB, regenerated daily, so pin a dated copy when fetching). Download from a mirror or the robot/harvest endpoint as the robot policy asks, not by crawling the site.
